projects.name: UTSA FindMySpot
projects.tagline: Computer vision that detects open parking spots from existing campus cameras at 10 FPS and pushes real-time availability to students — 90% detection accuracy, no new hardware on the lots.

projects.name: FairLane
projects.tagline: AI that catches its own bias — FairLane audits every loan decision across demographic variants before a human signs off, turning fairness from an after-the-fact report into a gate.

projects.name: CityShield
projects.tagline: Situational awareness agent for the 2026 World Cup — monitors crowd density, traffic flow, and public sentiment together to flag crowd-crush risk before it forms.

projects.name: FinalStint
projects.tagline: F1-themed Pomodoro clock with an interactive archives hub and race-inspired stats that predict your next session's performance.
